description: Keyword search of mail (BM25 over subject, sender, own words), every list unless inbox narrows it. Messages best first (collapse_threads: one per thread): inbox, message_id, subject, from, date, thread_id, excerpt; total, has_more. For exact words; questions: hybrid_search. complete=false: out of budget_ms or total is a lower bound. define:<term> adds definition.

collapse_threads.description: One hit per thread, the best (default false)

inbox.description: all (default), a list, or several comma-separated

query.description: Words. Operators: after:/before:, d:A..B, site:, from:, intitle:, intext:, to:/cc:, has:patch, link:, /regex/, -op; alone: newest first

since.description: On or after: YYYY[-MM[-DD]], ISO, or 2w/6m/1y ago

name: search
